labels.ideal_content_profile: Big emotional life-moment storytelling — proposals, weddings, reunions; wide landscape reveals into intimate reaction close-ups.
Drone landscape reveals, slow coastal b-roll, wide ambient shots.
Slow handheld emotional moments — couples, candid embraces, intimate hand details.
Wedding-day montages — getting ready, first looks, reception celebrations.
Drone footage with rhythmic synth pulses; landscape b-roll with cool atmospherics.
Street fashion, swagger walks, fast cuts.

ranked.rationale: This track is purpose-built for emotional life-pivot moments like proposals, perfectly matching the clips' dramatic and intimate scenes.
The intimate and tender acoustic sound beautifully complements the candid emotional reactions and embraces in the clips.
Its sweeping and spacious vibe is excellent for the wide drone shots and scenic cliff views, providing a sense of grandeur.
The ambient and ethereal atmospherics could provide a modern, spacious backdrop for the scenic and emotional moments.
While celebratory, its high energy might overpower some of the more tender, intimate proposal moments, though it fits the 'yes' reaction.
The track's energetic swagger and street attitude are completely mismatched with the romantic, emotional proposal clips.

meta.case: cinematic proposal sunset — second cinematic case, acoustic for diversity
